_readme: Single source of truth for every third-party tool vendored into the
launcher zip / MSI and installed by CI for the test suite. To upgrade a
tool, bump its version AND url together: the packaging scripts detect the
change (the vendored dir's .pinned-source marker no longer matches),
re-download, and fail the build if the downloaded binary does not report
gcloud is the one tool with no versioned download: Google only publishes
the bundled-python Windows archive at the rolling rapid-channel url, so
the build downloads that and verifies the archive's VERSION file against
the pin - when Google moves the channel forward the build fails loudly
